name: Edogawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Edogawa ward emblem in white: a stylised bird in flight with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Edogawa, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1965.

features.role: Edogawa ward emblem — a stylised bird in flight with a disc
